## [1.3.1](https://github.com/neoKushan/smortthings/compare/v1.3.0...v1.3.1) (2026-11-22)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* avoid device-open crash on Samsung (skip signature-protected keyboard provider query) ([e36c3b7](https://github.com/neoKushan/smortthings/commit/e36c3b7e09276426dd672b5bded1822c436ebfc3))

patches.name: Allow install on Samsung phones
patches.description: Removes duplicate permission declarations that block installing the patched app on Samsung phones (INSTALL_FAILED_DUPLICATE_PERMISSION). Enable this only if the install fails on a Samsung device; it is unnecessary on non-Samsung phones.

patches.name: LocalThings Owner PSK in device settings
patches.description: Shows a device's OwnerPSK (for Home Assistant LocalThings) on its Edit screen, extracted locally via the app's own key store. Tested on HW-Q950A / SmartThings 1.8.52.23.

patches.name: Use web login on Samsung phones
patches.description: Lets the re-signed app sign in and open devices on a Samsung phone: forces the non-Samsung web Samsung Account login and skips Samsung signature-protected calls the re-signed app can't make. Enable it alongside "Allow install on Samsung phones" if login fails or devices crash on open. Unnecessary on non-Samsung phones.
